issues.detail: Rule's spec_quote only covers if(L); else/q_in is unsupported and the required q-bit transform is omitted.
Port/width mismatch: spec has 3-bit r and 3-bit registered q; contract uses 1-bit r_in, extra q_in, and 1-bit Q.
Missing required hierarchical design in S16/S17: no top_module submodule with flipflop+mux instantiated three times.
issues.spec_evidence: You want to create a hierarchical Verilog design where a flipflop and 2-1 multiplexer are in a submodule, and that submodule is instantiated three times in this code.

issues.detail: q_in is an ungrounded extra input; if L=0 should hold prior Q instead of loading q_in, behavior differs. Sequence distinguishes: contract Q=0 after row2; hold alternative Q=1.
issues.alternative: When L=0, hold the previous Q instead of loading q_in.
